channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Over 16% of Japanese companies experience data breaches
item.description: According to the survey, 30.2% of large companies suffered or potentially suffered breaches, significantly higher than 14.3% among small businesses.

item.title: Japan to restart accepting foreign workers for meal services at some facilities
item.description: The government aims to adopt the plan at a Cabinet meeting in December.

item.title: New species of sperm whale identified from fossils found in Gunma
item.description: The species combines traits of ancient and modern sperm whales, and is the third new sperm whale species identified from fossils in Japan.

item.title: Tensions overshadow 70th anniversary of key Japan-Soviet declaration
item.description: In response to Japanese sanctions, Russia has suspended peace treaty talks and asserted that a territorial dispute has been settled.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
